title: Winter Comfort on Broadway
content: The hearty winter menu is in full swing at Eleanor's. Join us Tuesday through Sunday for pot roast, Shepherd's Pie, and a warm room while it's cold out. Closed Mondays as always.
excerpt: Hearty winter cooking has returned to Eleanor's Tavern.

title: Announcing Our American Craft Wine Tasting Series
content: We're proud to launch our American Craft Wine Tasting Series with our partners at Hudson Valley Wine Imports. Five wines, five small plates from Chef Daniel, one great evening. First seating this fall.
excerpt: A new evening of American wine and small plates.

title: Eleanor's Pot Roast: The Story Behind Our Signature Dish
content: Eleanor's Pot Roast has been on our menu since the day we opened in 2015. It's my grandmother's recipe, braised low and slow with root vegetables. Here's the story behind the $28 plate that started it all.
excerpt: The recipe my grandmother passed down.

title: Presidents' Day Weekend Hours
content: We'll be open our regular Tuesday-Sunday hours over Presidents' Day weekend. Closed Monday as always. Reservations recommended for Saturday dinner.
excerpt: Holiday weekend schedule at the tavern.

title: New on the Menu: Charred Octopus & Maple Roasted Carrots
content: Chef Daniel has added Charred Octopus ($16) to our starters and Maple Roasted Carrots ($7) to our sides. Both are on the menu this winter.
excerpt: Two new dishes from the kitchen.

title: Book the Tavern for Your Private Event
content: Looking to host a rehearsal dinner, birthday, or office party? Our back room seats up to 30, and we offer family-style menus built around Eleanor's Pot Roast and Chef Daniel's seasonal plates. Email carlton@eleanorstavern.com to inquire.
excerpt: Host your celebration at Eleanor's Tavern.

title: We're in Eater NY!
content: We were thrilled to be mentioned in Eater NY's roundup of Astoria's best neighborhood taverns. Thank you to everyone who has supported us over the past eleven years. Come say hi.
excerpt: A kind mention from Eater NY.

title: Three New American Craft Beers on Tap
content: We've refreshed our taps with three new American craft beers, sourced through Five Boroughs Beverage. Ask Nina at the bar for a recommendation.

title: Restaurant Week at the Tavern
content: Join us for NYC Restaurant Week. We'll be running a prix-fixe built around Eleanor's Pot Roast, plus a bourbon flight special ($22) all weekend. Reservations open now.

title: Our Spring Menu Is Coming
content: As winter winds down, Chef Daniel is putting the finishing touches on our spring menu. Expect lighter plates alongside the clay-pot dishes and a Seasonal Cobbler that changes with what's good.
excerpt: A preview of the spring menu.

title: Pickup Soccer & Sunday Jazz
content: Sundays are for slowing down. We play jazz on the speakers all evening and the kitchen runs a relaxed Sunday menu. Stop in after a walk along the East River.

title: Thank You, Astoria: 11 Years of Eleanor's Tavern
content: Eleven years ago we opened our doors on Broadway with my grandmother's pot roast recipe and a hope that the neighborhood would have us. You did. Thank you for eleven wonderful years.

title: Valentine's Day at the Tavern
content: Spend Valentine's evening with us. We'll be running a special couples menu alongside our regular dishes, with a glass of American sparkling to start. Reservations recommended.
excerpt: A cozy Valentine's evening on Broadway.

title: Meet Chef Daniel McGee
content: Behind every plate at Eleanor's is my brother Daniel, our head chef since day one. He talks fishing trips, clay-pot cooking, and why the pot roast will never leave the menu.
excerpt: A chat with our head chef.

title: St. Patrick's Day Specials
content: Join us for Shepherd's Pie and a pint this St. Patrick's Day. Chef Daniel is running a corned beef special all day.
excerpt: Shepherd's Pie and pints for the day.

title: Now Taking Reservations Online
content: You can now book your table at Eleanor's directly from our website. Weekend nights fill up fast, so reserve early.
excerpt: Booking a table just got easier.

title: Spring Menu Refresh
content: Chef Daniel is planning a spring refresh, with fresh fish from Atlantic Seafood and new sides on the way. We'll share more as the weather turns.
excerpt: A look ahead at the spring refresh.

title: Gift Cards Now Available Online
content: Give the gift of a tavern dinner. Eleanor's gift cards are now available to buy online, perfect for birthdays and the holidays.
excerpt: The gift of a tavern dinner.

title: Sourcing Close to Home This Winter
content: We're proud to source produce from Greenmarket Produce Partners and fish from local Atlantic Seafood Supply. Here's how we keep it close to home.

title: Winter Tavern Playlist
content: The dining room has its own winter soundtrack, a mix of Springsteen, Tom Petty, jazz, and Americana. Pull up a chair and stay a while.
excerpt: The sound of a winter night at the tavern.
